judge.rationale: The candidate stopped at the 'Red' phase of TDD: it wrote a failing acceptance test (`src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts`) and updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, but never modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to actually fix the bug. Consequently, `npm test` will fail because the newly added acceptance test fails against the unedited implementation. Additionally, the candidate completely omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` update and left a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file in the repository. On the positive side, the test logic and spec update wording closely match the reference PR.
